stories.title: Terre Haute man found with several guns after allegedly threatening IMPD detective, 2 Indianapolis families
stories.summary: In addition to seizing a "large number" of firearms during a search warrant, the sheriff's office said deputies also found narcotics in the suspect's home.

stories.title: Irvington schools to resume classes Monday after fallout over financial cuts, teacher call-offs
stories.summary: The announcement of the schools' re-openings comes less than 24 hours after the Mayor's Office of Education Innovation threatened to revoke the district's charters.

stories.title: Memorial bike ride honors Indianapolis traffic crash victims
stories.summary: The group Central Indiana Cycling organized the memorial to honor those killed in traffic incidents and give their families an opportunity to share their stories.

stories.title: Pat Sullivan shares tips on how to be a good host this holiday season.
stories.summary: Pat Sullivan with Sullivan Hardware and Garden is back and this week he's sharing tips on how to prepare for having company over this holiday season.

stories.title: Irvington schools face deadlines to fix staffing, financial issues after school closures, community pushback
stories.summary: In a new letter provided to 13News, the Indianapolis Mayor's Office of Education Innovation is threatening to revoke Irvington Community School district's charters.

stories.title: Here's who won the 2026 Bands of America Grand National Championship
stories.summary: Almost 100 high school marching bands from across the country took part in the competition at Lucas Oil Stadium.

stories.title: What does Thanksgiving air travel look like after nationwide ground stop?
stories.summary: Delays and cancellations are the realities for thousands of flyers after a nationwide ground stop. But will it last forever?

stories.title: 13-year-old boy arrested for arson after Anderson playground fire
stories.summary: Police said the preliminary investigation showed "several" juveniles between 12 and 13 years old were involved in setting fire to playground equipment at May Park.

stories.title: 'Multiple' explosions caused by propane tanks exacerbate Reelsville barn fire
stories.summary: No one was injured during the fire, officials said, but the barn and all its contents were considered total losses.

stories.title: Travelers face delays, cancellations at Indianapolis International Airport after nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: Travelers at Indianapolis International Airport faced canceled flights, long delays and unexpected expenses on Saturday following Friday’s nationwide ground stop.

stories.title: Man arrested for OWI after 3-car crash kills woman, injures 2 others on Indy's near northwest side
stories.summary: The crash happened around 12:25 a.m. Nov. 14 at the intersection of West 30th Street and North Tibbs Avenue.

stories.title: Charges filed against man who allegedly set ex-girlfriend's car on fire with Molotov cocktail
stories.summary: The man is facing felony charges after he allegedly sent his ex-girlfriend threatening messages on Snapchat and set her car on fire in Greensburg.
